or raw system/network logs. Include only relevant, reviewed counters or redacted error messages.
请勿上传凭据、完整EFI、机器或网络身份；只提供相关且已检查的数值诊断或脱敏错误。

This beta is tested only on AX210 / macOS 24H23. See RELEASE_NOTES.md for unsupported features
and unverified reliability scenarios. Report this fork's issues here rather than to OpenIntelWireless.
